classification: Independent CPU-only pinned-source semantic, physical-byte, license, and actual-extractor review; no retrieval or inference

semantic_review.reason: The response body setter assigns a default string media type only when Content-Type is absent and computes UTF-8 byte length. The application respond function ends a HEAD response without transmitting its body. These are two necessary implementation layers in distinct files.
semantic_review.scope_note: Existing content types are respected; external MIME and Node implementations are outside lib scope.

semantic_review.reason: Application.handleRequest connects middleware rejection and response completion errors to context.onerror. The latter emits the application error, clears prior headers for an unwritten writable response, chooses a valid status or 500, discloses the message only when err.expose is set, and sends text with a byte length. Both files are required.
semantic_review.scope_note: The question explicitly limits the reply behavior to an unwritten writable response. Header-sent/unwritable errors still emit and then return. External event/status lookup internals are outside scope.

semantic_review.reason: The local is-stream helper recognizes native or compatible readable streams; the response body setter attaches completion cleanup and clears stale Content-Length when appropriate; application.respond pipelines the stream and forwards an error through context.onerror when an application error listener exists. All three file groups are necessary.
semantic_review.scope_note: Replacing one stream with another attaches an error sink to the prior stream; the setter destroys the prior stream immediately only when the replacement is not a stream. The labels and wording do not promise unconditional immediate destruction. Node pipeline, on-finished, and destroy internals are excluded.

semantic_review.reason: The ips getter accepts forwarded addresses only when proxy trust is enabled and limits the retained tail to the configured positive hop count. The ip getter selects the first retained address or socket fallback and stores the result under its private cache symbol. Both complete getter bodies are required, in one file.
semantic_review.scope_note: The query requests local trust/selection/cache behavior rather than the internals of the comma-splitting dependency.

semantic_review.reason: The complete redirect method normalizes absolute HTTP(S) destinations, encodes Location, preserves an existing redirect status, and selects escaped HTML or plain text through accepted-format negotiation. Its full body covers the requested behavior.
semantic_review.scope_note: URL encoding, HTML escaping, and Accept negotiation dependency implementations are outside the declared source scope.

semantic_review.reason: The fresh getter explicitly rejects methods other than GET/HEAD and statuses outside 2xx/304, and otherwise calls the freshness dependency with request and response headers. The local guard is fully represented.
semantic_review.scope_note: The labels cover the local method/status gate, not the external conditional-header comparison algorithm.

semantic_review.reason: The seven-file lib inventory implements an inbound HTTP server and middleware/response helpers. The local HTTP createServer call and redirect URL handling do not implement an outbound body-URL fetcher or exponential retry/backoff.
semantic_review.scope_note: Absence is limited to this pinned tracked lib membership; user middleware, tests, dependencies, and the broader ecosystem are excluded.

semantic_review.reason: The final response path serializes objects as JSON and sends the bytes. Application keys feed signed cookies, and request.socket.encrypted indicates TLS. These are distinct from tenant-scoped rotating JSON body encryption and a payload key identifier.
semantic_review.scope_note: Absence is limited to this pinned tracked lib membership; arbitrary user middleware or dependency cryptography is outside scope.

absence_review.method: Read the public implementation roles and relevant bodies in all seven tracked lib files; inspect matching source for potentially misleading terms. Keyword absence alone was not treated as proof.

source_inventory.lib/application.js: Inbound server, middleware dispatch, and final response conversion
source_inventory.lib/context.js: Request/response delegation, error replies, and signed cookies
source_inventory.lib/request.js: Inbound request headers, addresses, query, TLS protocol, and freshness accessors
source_inventory.lib/response.js: Output body, headers, status, relocation, and stream helpers

observed_decoys: socket.encrypted supplies a TLS protocol indication
JSON.stringify serializes a response without body encryption

applicability.source_review_result: Suitable as a prospective repository retrieval corpus with source-authored labels.
applicability.comparative_result: Non-discriminating for the current clause-fusion rule. A single-list equal-weight RRF is monotonic in the full-query rank and supplies no clause-fusion contrast. Fresh duplicate-query variation would not establish a fusion effect.
applicability.decision: Preserve all query texts and the failed comparative applicability gate; no inference is authorized by this review.
